name: grade_web
idea: Phone/browser editor for grade_dashboard courses: a Google Apps Script web app over course files in a Google Drive folder (view + edit scores, take attendance, fill column, edit weights/boundaries), with an edit journal that grader web-pull merges back into the Mac copy; grader web-push copies courses to Drive. grade-tui untouched.

tasks.title: **CMRU spike, thin end to end**: a "hello" Apps Script web app that also lists the folder names under `My Drive/grade_web/` (phone → Apps Script → Drive). Plus `spikeRoundTrip_()`, run once from the editor on a fake Thai + BOM + CRLF CSV

**`grader web-push`**: read-only checks, staging copy, `build_course_json`, copy the pushed set, stale-file removal, `--force` discard archive, Drive-root resolution through `Path.home()` (fake HOME in tests) and the test guard, cwd default, `--debug` (one-line error without it). Fixture F1 and its integrity test

**`grader web-pull`**: net change, classification against the Mac, preview, `--yes` through `apply_edits(entry=e)` + `update_course_config` in **one** history entry, Mac-wins config rule, archive on Drive + copy in history, idempotent, `-y`/`--yes`, `--debug`. Optional `entry=None` (backward compatible) added to `apply_edits`/`_sync_total`/`_sync_attendance`/`attendance.auto_sync`

**Grade math in JS + golden parity**: `classify`, `sameCell`, `mergeCourse`, `fillDefaultMax`, `computeGrades` (with per-student `dropped`), `letterGrade`, `round2`, plus CSV parse (`csv.js`, read side). `make_golden.py` (using T2's `build_course_json` + `get_course_data`) writes the golden files, variants, `csv_rows.json` and `canonical.json`. Fixtures F2-F4

**Web app shell**: `listCourses` + `loadCourse` under the lock with trim, owner check, course availability (missing course.json, conflict copies, damaged journal), `older_push`, read-only course view with push time. Journal summary formatters (`fmtTime`, `fmtAgo`, `journalLine`). Server harness. clasp deploy and paste-in README, plus the README's "Duplicate files" and "Damaged journal" procedures (SPEC "Hand-repair procedures"). Repo hygiene test

**Column mode**: pick a counted column (grouped by category, attendance sessions included, no totals). Students in Raw Details order with ID/name/value. Numeric keypad input, Next, `ขส`, Clear, refusal of `8,5`/negatives/text, over-max red, `*` + "N unsaved" badge, clear-back removes the edit, ID/name search, last column remembered per device (`gw:ui:<folder>`)

**Save, draft, Undo**: `saveBatch` with the conflict check, pending marker + roll-forward, journal append, cell splice. Retry, Discard, leave-page warning, localStorage draft with age, storage-refused warning. `undoLastSave` (newest first, conflicts kept). `<J>.undo.edits` (first 10 cells + count) for the Undo dialog. Message formatters `saveResult`, `draftAge`, `undoTitle`, `undoResult` in `journal.js` ("(N files)" from `columns[].file`). `gas_run.js` and `e2e.sh` (all steps except 6e)

**Student detail and wide table**: tap a student for the full row with per-category weighted %, `dropped` mark, Coursework Total, Final Score and Grade, live from saved values + unsaved edits, editable there. Wide screens get the whole course table with the same marks and editing; narrow widths fall back to column mode

**Attendance and Fill**: session column with today preselected, P/L/A/X taps that move to the next student, `EA` shown and kept, no session add/rename/remove, never touching the xlsx. Fill: whole column or only empty cells (unsaved values count as filled), "N cells will change", 0 does nothing, validation, attendance choices P/L/A/X/Clear

**Weights and boundaries editor**: `saveConfig` with a journaled `config` line, number validation naming the field, fixed key sets, boundaries strictly descending in stored letter order (else `INVALID` naming the letter; never re-sorted), sum ≠ 1 warning (Save allowed), stale-config refusal. Totals recompute (weight-derived maxima included). e2e step 6e
